descricao_original: In most cases, special sensory stimuli are transduced by receptor cells and the signal is carried by a dendrite toward the cell body. An axon leaves the cell body from its opposite pole to form a cranial nerve that enters the brain. Axonal and dendritic processes cannot be differentiated in this image.
